summary: Iteration 86 - Login Wallpaper Feature Testing Complete. All backend APIs (11/11 tests) and frontend features working correctly. Login page displays animated time-of-day greeting with bouncing emoji, typing effect cycling through 5 headlines, particle network animation, and wallpaper background from settings. Settings page wallpaper section allows Default/Templates/Upload selection with 6 template options and overlay opacity slider.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing Cyber City template wallpaper
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login wallpaper feature fully tested. Current wallpaper is set to 'Cyber City' template. Key endpoints: GET /api/settings/login-wallpaper (public, no auth), GET /api/settings/login-wallpaper/templates (auth required, returns 6 templates), PUT /api/settings/login-wallpaper (auth required), POST /api/settings/login-wallpaper/upload (auth required, accepts image files). Login page has 3 animated features: (1) Time-of-day greeting with bouncing emoji using floatBounce animation, (2) Typing effect cycling through Command Center/NOC Dashboard/Service Desk/Asset Manager/Security Hub, (3) ParticleField canvas with 60 particles and connecting lines. Settings wallpaper section is in My Settings > Display tab.
